test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who succeeded M. Venkaiah Naidu as the Vice President of India in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagdeep Dhankhar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagdeep Dhankhar** succeeded **M. Venkaiah Naidu** as the **Vice President of India** on **August 11, 2022**, following the completion of Naidu's term.
 
• He was elected as the **14th Vice President of India** and is also the **Chairman of the Rajya Sabha**, as per the constitutional provision of the Vice President's role.
 
• Jagdeep Dhankhar is a seasoned politician and lawyer, having previously served as the **Governor of West Bengal** from **July 2019 to July 2022**.
 
• The election for the Vice President was held on **August 6, 2022**, and Dhankhar emerged victorious by securing a significant majority of votes, defeating the opposition candidate **Margaret Alva**.
 
• The Vice President of India is elected by an electoral college consisting of the **Members of Parliament (MPs) from both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha**. This election is conducted by secret ballot, following the system of proportional representation by a single transferable vote.
 
• Jagdeep Dhankhar's leadership and extensive experience in politics, law, and governance played a crucial role in his selection for this esteemed position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jagdeep Dhankhar:**

 
 
• **Born:** May 18, 1951, in **Kithana, Rajasthan**, Jagdeep Dhankhar is known for his distinguished career in both politics and law.
 
• He served as a Member of Parliament (MP) from **Jhunjhunu constituency** in Rajasthan during 1989-1991 and has been associated with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• He has also served as the Minister of State for Parliamentary Affairs in the **Chandra Shekhar government** (1990-1991).
 
 
 
• **Role of the Vice President of India:**
 
 
• The Vice President is the **second-highest constitutional office** in India after the President. The primary responsibility is to act as the **Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha**.
 
• In the event of the President's absence, resignation, or removal, the Vice President may act as the **President of India** temporarily.
 
 
 
• **M. Venkaiah Naidu:**
 
 
• **M. Venkaiah Naidu** served as the **13th Vice President of India** from **August 11, 2017, to August 10, 2022**.
 
• He is a prominent leader from the BJP and is well-known for his contributions to policy-making and governance during his tenure.
 
 
 
• **Other Candidates for Vice President in 2022:**
 
 
• **Margaret Alva**, the opposition candidate, contested against Dhankhar but lost the election with a significant margin.
 
• The election showcased the importance of strong political alliances, as Dhankhar secured the backing of the **NDA (National Democratic Alliance)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Election Process:**

 
 
• The Vice President is elected through an electoral college comprising **Members of Parliament** (MPs) from both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha.
 
• The election is conducted using a **single transferable vote** system through a secret ballot.
 
 
 
• **Vice President's Tenure:**
 
 
• The Vice President serves a term of **five years** but can be re-elected for subsequent terms.
 
• In case of resignation or removal, the Vice President can vacate the office before completing the term.
